title: Total Angular Momentum
description: Essential Criteria - The student must correctly identify the total angular momentum as sqrt(2) hbar.

title: Expectation Value Lz
description: Essential Criteria - The student must correctly calculate the expectation value of Lz as 0.

title: Probability Lz = +hbar
description: Essential Criteria - The student must correctly determine the probability of measuring Lz = +hbar as 1/6.

title: Probability in Solid Angle
description: Essential Criteria - The student must provide the correct expression for the probability in solid angle dOmega.

title: Normalization Constant
description: Important Criteria - The student should show understanding of the normalization constant K' and its derivation.

title: Angular Part of Wave Function
description: Important Criteria - The student should correctly express the angular part of the wave function in spherical coordinates.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the angular momentum calculations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student should ensure that units are consistent throughout the calculations.
